name: local-storage-rules
description: Always-on global rule enforcing that working files, temporary scratch scripts, caches, and build outputs are written strictly to data drives (E: or D:) rather than filling up the Windows C: system drive.
suggestedPrompts: 检查当前工作区命令是否已将临时目录重定向到非 C 盘
在当前数据盘工作区创建 _tmp 目录用于存放临时评测脚本与中间产物
根据我的磁盘盘符自定义 local-storage-rules 的目标数据盘设置
